description: Take a bad character sheet out of a series (wrong outfit, wrong look, a failed or unusable sheet) so its slot can be used for a new one: a series holds 6 sheets that are not archived or failed. Free. Nothing is deleted: videos already made keep their images; the archived sheet can no longer start a clip or star in an episode. Refused (SHEET_IN_SEASON_PLAN) while the confirmed season plan names the sheet: put the new sheet id in the plan first. Refused (SHEET_IN_FLIGHT) while it is still being made. Archiving does not reset the daily limit on new sheets.

sheetId.description: The sheet to archive, from autoshort_get_character_sheet.
